_meta.description: System-level connectivity rules for the OCA visual builder per BS-SPEC-OCA-002-REV0 §6.3

interaction_rules.name: filter_upstream_particle_mitigation
interaction_rules.description: Adding an upstream filter removes the unfiltered-particle pathway for downstream components, subject to bypass/integrity assumptions. Particle impact assessments update accordingly.
interaction_rules.trigger: Filter added upstream of component with particle_impact credible or indeterminate
interaction_rules.provenance: TM §4.3.1 — particle impact requires particles in flow

interaction_rules.name: dead_end_rapid_pressurization
interaction_rules.description: Dead-end volume downstream of fast-opening valve creates rapid pressurization hazard when nonmetal is present at dead end.
interaction_rules.trigger: Topology detects dead-end volume AND upstream valve with fast opening profile
assumptions: Pressurization rate dependent on valve opening profile

interaction_rules.name: sonic_orifice_resonance
interaction_rules.description: Orifice at sonic conditions with downstream cavity creates resonance hazard.
interaction_rules.trigger: Orifice with pressure ratio > 1.89 AND downstream cavity or branch tube detected
interaction_rules.provenance: TM §4.3.1 — resonance requires sonic jet into cavity

interaction_rules.name: nonflammable_body_breaks_chain
interaction_rules.description: Changing body material to a nonflammable alloy (e.g., Monel 400) can break the kindling chain if the body was the propagation path.
interaction_rules.trigger: Component body material changed to flammability_rating A or B
assumptions: Body is the primary propagation barrier
Material verified nonflammable at service conditions
interaction_rules.provenance: TM §4.4 — kindling chain requires continuous flammable path

interaction_rules.name: velocity_reduction_particle_impact
interaction_rules.description: Increasing line diameter reduces estimated velocity. If velocity drops below 30 m/s threshold, particle impact characteristic element is no longer satisfied.
interaction_rules.trigger: Line inner_diameter_mm increased such that calculated velocity < 30 m/s
assumptions: Calculation from system input v = Q/A
interaction_rules.provenance: TM §4.3.1, ASTM STP 986 — 30 m/s (100 ft/s) particle impact threshold

interaction_rules.name: slow_actuator_pressurization
interaction_rules.description: Adding a slow-opening actuator (>1 second pressurization time) reduces rapid pressurization credibility by removing the 'rapid' characteristic element.
interaction_rules.trigger: Valve opening_profile changed from fast to slow
assumptions: No other rapid pressurization source upstream

interaction_rules.name: mpr53_pressure_boundary
interaction_rules.description: Moving relief valve set pressure below 265 psia removes MPR 53 acceptance test requirement for that component. This is a Tier A requirement boundary, not a heuristic.
interaction_rules.trigger: System max pressure <= 265 psia OR component is exempt per MPR 53

interaction_rules.name: cleanliness_particle_credit
interaction_rules.description: Applying a high-standard cleaning specification provides particle impact mitigation credit for short-duration missions by reducing contamination baseline.
interaction_rules.trigger: cleanliness_spec set to high standard (e.g., IEST-STD-CC1246E Level 100)
